records.jp: こころー。<CR>どしたの？　なんかあった？
records.en_original: Kokoro, what are you up to?
records.en: Kokoro, what are you up to?

records.jp: あ、愛央ちゃん。<CR>実は、日記がなくなっちゃって……
records.en_original: Oh, hi Ao. I seem to have lost my diary...
records.en: Oh, hi Ao-chan. I seem to have lost my diary...

records.jp: 日記って、こころがいつもつけてるやつ？
records.en_original: Your diary? The one you've been writing in every day?
records.en: Your diary? The one you've been writing in every day?

records.jp: うん……。<CR>教室の中探したんだけど見つからなくって
records.en_original: Yeah. I looked all over the classroom, but I couldn't find it.
records.en: Yeah. I looked all over the classroom, but I couldn't find it.

records.jp: そりゃ大変。私も探すの手伝うよ
records.en_original: Oh, no! I'll help you look for it!
records.en: Oh, no! I'll help you look for it!

records.jp: 本当？　ありがとう、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Really? Thank you, Ao.
records.en: Really? Thank you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: いいっていいって。<CR>最近、外に日記持ち出したりとかしたの？
records.en_original: No problem. Have you taken the diary with you outside recently?
records.en: No problem. Have you taken the diary with you outside recently?

records.jp: それが、全然記憶にないんだよね。<CR>昨日まではちゃんと教室にあったし……
records.en_original: That's just it. I don't remember. And I know I had it in the classroom yesterday...
records.en: That's just it. I don't remember. And I know I had it in the classroom yesterday...

records.jp: とりあえず、他のみんなにも聞いてみる？
records.en_original: Maybe we should ask the others if they've seen it.
records.en: Maybe we should ask the others if they've seen it.

records.jp: そうだね。そうしよう
records.en_original: That's a good idea.
records.en: That's a good idea.

records.jp: 靭さんの日記？
records.en_original: Utsubo's diary?
records.en: Utsubo-san's diary?

records.jp: このくらいの大きさのノートで……
records.en_original: It's a notebook about this big, and—
records.en: It's a notebook about this big, and—

records.jp: いや、モノは知ってるけど。<CR>私は特に触ったりしてないよ
records.en_original: I know what it looks like. But I haven't touched it.
records.en: I know what it looks like. But I haven't touched it.

records.jp: 私も知らないなあ……。<CR>もし見かけたらすぐ知らせるね
records.en_original: I haven't seen it either... I'll let you know if I do, though.
records.en: I haven't seen it either... I'll let you know if I do, though.

records.jp: うん、ありがとう
records.en_original: Okay. Thank you.
records.en: Okay. Thank you.

records.jp: あれ、皆さんどうしたんですか？
records.en_original: Oh, hello everyone. Is everything all right?
records.en: Oh, hello everyone. Is everything all right?

records.jp: あ、詩帆さん。<CR>実はこころの日記が行方不明になっちゃって
records.en_original: Hi, Shiho. Well, Kokoro's diary went missing.
records.en: Hi, Shiho-san. Well, Kokoro's diary went missing.

records.jp: みんなに聞いて回ってたの
records.en_original: We're going around asking if anyone has seen it.
records.en: We're going around asking if anyone has seen it.

records.jp: こころの……？<CR>それって、もしかしてこれですか？
records.en_original: Kokoro's diary? You mean this?
records.en: Kokoro's diary? You mean this?

records.jp: あ、それ！
records.en_original: That's it!
records.en: That's it!

records.jp: 作業室に置き忘れてあって……。こころの名前が<CR>書いてあったから、渡そうと思って探してたんです
records.en_original: It was left in the work room. I saw your name on it, so I came looking for you, Kokoro.
records.en: It was left in the work room. I saw your name on it, so I came looking for you, Kokoro.

records.jp: 作業室……。あ、そっか。<CR>ご飯の前に書こうと思って持ってってたんだっけ
records.en_original: The work room... That's right. I took it with me so I could write in it before lunch.
records.en: The work room... That's right. I took it with me so I could write in it before lunch.

records.jp: 良かった……。<CR>見つけてくれてありがとう、詩帆ちゃん
records.en_original: That's a relief... Thank you so much, Shiho.
records.en: That's a relief... Thank you so much, Shiho-chan.

records.jp: 良かったね、こころ
records.en_original: I'm happy for you, Kokoro.
records.en: I'm happy for you, Kokoro.

records.jp: 人騒がせなんだから……。<CR>大切なものなんでしょ。今度から気を付けて
records.en_original: False alarm... That diary is important to you, isn't it? You should be more careful with it.
records.en: False alarm... That diary is important to you, isn't it? You should be more careful with it.

records.jp: うん。ごめんね、時間とらせちゃって
records.en_original: Yeah. Sorry to have bothered you.
records.en: Yeah. Sorry to have bothered you.

records.jp: ……見つかって良かったね
records.en_original: ...I'm glad you got it back, though.
records.en: ...I'm glad you got it back, though.

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃん、本当にありがとね
records.en_original: Thank you again, Shiho.
records.en: Thank you again, Shiho-chan.

records.jp: ……こころは、本当に変わったね
records.en_original: ...You really have changed, Kokoro.
records.en: ...You really have changed, Kokoro.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: 一人で抱え込まずに人を頼れるようになって……<CR>友達もたくさんできて
records.en_original: You're reaching out to others instead of struggling alone. And look how many friends you have now.
records.en: You're reaching out to others instead of struggling alone. And look how many friends you have now.

records.jp: ……本当に、良かった
records.en_original: That makes me very happy.
records.en: That makes me very happy.

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃん……。<CR>それも、詩帆ちゃんが励ましてくれたおかげだよ
records.en_original: Oh, Shiho... It's all thanks to the encouragement you gave me.
records.en: Oh, Shiho-chan... It's all thanks to the encouragement you gave me.

records.jp: ううん。わたしの言葉なんて、きっかけの一つに<CR>過ぎなかったと思う
records.en_original: Not at all. All I did was give you a little push.
records.en: Not at all. All I did was give you a little push.

records.jp: 聞かせてもらってもいいかな？<CR>わたしと別れてから、今までのこころのこと
records.en_original: Would you mind telling me all about what you have been doing since we went our separate ways?
records.en: Would you mind telling me all about what you have been doing since we went our separate ways?

records.jp: こころ？
records.en_original: Kokoro?
records.en: Kokoro?

records.jp: う、うん。また今度、ゆっくり話そうね
records.en_original: U-um, sure. Let's make some time to talk later.
records.en: U-um, sure. Let's make some time to talk later.

records.jp: ふふ、楽しみにしてるね
records.en_original: Hehe, I can't wait.
records.en: Hehe, I can't wait.

records.jp: ……こころ、どうかした？<CR>なんか顔色悪いけど
records.en_original: Are you okay, Kokoro? You look a bit pale.
records.en: Are you okay, Kokoro? You look a bit pale.

records.jp: ううん。大丈夫。<CR>愛央ちゃんも、日記探すの手伝ってくれてありがとね
records.en_original: Oh, I'm fine. Thank you for helping me look for my diary, Ao.
records.en: Oh, I'm fine. Thank you for helping me look for my diary, Ao-chan.

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Sure...
records.en: Sure...
